as_read: No oral efficacy trial of goldenseal found; the human trials read measure drug interactions, and 'null' here means no affirmative finding, not that goldenseal was tested and failed.

quote.text: Thus, large randomized, double-blind clinical studies need to be conducted on goldenseal supplements and their main alkaloids to provide more evidence on the mechanisms responsible for the pharmaceutical activity, clinical efficacy and safety of these products.

rejection.search: PubMed, (goldenseal[tiab] OR "Hydrastis canadensis"[tiab]) AND (randomized[tiab] OR randomised[tiab] OR placebo[tiab] OR trial[tiab] OR "systematic review"[tiab] OR humans[mh]): 93, newest 30 listed. Then efficacy, treatment, symptoms, infection, immune or trial terms, excluding homeopathic and in vitro, with humans[mh]: 21, all listed. By title and opening text, none is an oral efficacy trial of goldenseal alone; the human trials are pharmacokinetic interaction studies.

stop_list: 327975 forms read Berberine; berberine trials are a different material and do not transfer here. No separate record is proposed.
clinician_items: 17495878: midazolam AUC 107.9 to 175.3 ng x h/ml after 14 days of goldenseal in 16 healthy volunteers; the authors warn of significant interactions with CYP3A substrates.
15900287: about 40% inhibition of CYP2D6 in a 28-day supplementation study of 12 healthy volunteers.
33174626: midazolam AUC GMR 1.43 and metformin AUC GMR 0.77 in 16 healthy volunteers; authors note possible unfavorable effects on glucose control.
39943692: in type 2 diabetes aggregate metformin AUC ratio 0.93, within the no-effect range, but about 20% lower at 500 to 750 mg metformin.
17079360: digoxin Cmax up 14% at 3210 mg daily goldenseal; no other significant digoxin parameter.
32683037: narrative review reports possible neurotoxic, hepatotoxic and phototoxic activities of goldenseal extract and its alkaloids.

21372858: NTP 2-year feed studies: clear evidence of carcinogenic activity of goldenseal root powder in male and female F344/N rats, some evidence in male B6C3F1 mice, none in female mice. Animal data, listed for the clinician; 21 of these labels print powder or plain goldenseal rows at 250 mg to 1 g.
